spec_match.rationale: One conditional+passive request with password: true on a page whose username uses autocomplete='username webauthn', per the explainer's coexistence section.

interactive.rationale: Radio toggle re-arms between passive and plain shapes; modal passkey button aborts and re-arms; password form submit; event log.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Blurb promises one request feeding both surfaces and the abort/re-arm pattern — implemented.

edge_cases.rationale: Which surface the user picked from cannot be observed by the page (both resolve the same promise) — stated rather than faked.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/5068149209825280, the explainer, spec PR #2485 and the Credential Management uiMode definition.

conformance.rationale: Feature suite asserts the conditionalPassiveGet capability, uiMode member read and 'passive' acceptance (pre-aborted signals, no request started), plus three manual assertions (non-modal UI, never-settling promise, autofill coexistence) — the never-settling check was made manual because a live request collides with the demo pages' own pending request; Chrome 153 (flag on) fails the capability assertion because it still reports the pre-rename key ambientGet — correct, but the spec-name path is not yet observed on a real build.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Both flag states: radio toggles re-armed, form submit message, passkey creation then conditional resolve, modal button resolved via virtual authenticator. Flag off labelled 'autofill / conditional only'. Console clean. Chrome for Testing 153.0.8010.12 headless via Playwright, desktop 1280x800 and mobile 360x740 DPR3 touch, each with and without --enable-features=WebAuthenticationAmbientSignin; CDP WebAuthn virtual authenticator used for the credential-present path; screenshots in the builder scratchpad (shots/).

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts single-request resolution separately for passive and conditional-only states, plus the fallback label.

design_system.rationale: Only design-system variables; status colours emerald-dark/rose on light surfaces; overridden buttons set both background and color.

accessibility.rationale: Native buttons/inputs with labels, 44px targets measured, visible focus from the design system, live regions for state; accessibility tree not inspected with chrome-devtools-mcp (unavailable here).

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: No horizontal overflow and no sub-44px targets at 360x740 DPR3 or 1280x800, both flag states. Note: Chromium exposes passive mode on desktop OSes only, so on Android the page shows the honest not-available state.

openQuestions.title: Capture the real passive bubble on a headed desktop Chrome/Canary
openQuestions.detail: Headless Chrome with a CDP virtual authenticator auto-selects the credential, so the non-modal prompt itself was never seen. Verify on headed Chrome 157+/Canary with chrome://flags/#web-authentication-ambient-signin that the bubble appears only with a credential and that ignoring it leaves the promise pending.

openQuestions.title: Verify autofill + bubble dedupe manually
openQuestions.detail: Confirm on headed Chrome that dismissing the passive bubble and then focusing Username shows the same credentials in autofill, and that picking either resolves once.

openQuestions.title: Inspect the accessibility tree with chrome-devtools-mcp
openQuestions.detail: chrome-devtools-mcp was unavailable in this environment (project rule 7b), so names/roles were checked via DOM queries only.

guidanceConsulted.query: passkey sign-in conditional mediation webauthn autofill
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Annotate username with autocomplete="username webauthn" and password with current-password; don't autofocus fields on pages that aren't dedicated sign-in pages.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Username uses 'username webauthn', password uses 'current-password'; no autofocus because the form is embedded in a larger demo page.

guidanceConsulted.query: passkey sign-in conditional mediation webauthn autofill
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Feature-detect with getClientCapabilities(), pass an AbortController signal to conditional get, treat AbortError/NotAllowedError as expected outcomes, abort the conditional request before a modal passkey button.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Every page probes getClientCapabilities() (spec key conditionalPassiveGet plus Chrome's earlier ambientGet), arms with a signal, and labels AbortError/NotAllowedError as non-sign-in outcomes. Exception: no server verification/Signal API — there is no RP backend; the page states the inspection is client-side only.

guidanceConsulted.query: live region status updates for async operation
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use native buttons/inputs with labels and a polite live region for asynchronous state changes.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: All controls are native buttons/inputs with visible labels; request state is mirrored to role=status/role=log regions; no ARIA widgets.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive control panel without horizontal overflow on mobile
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Wrap control rows with flex-wrap and let long tokens wrap rather than overflow.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Button rows use flex-wrap; headings/readouts use overflow-wrap:anywhere (fixed a 7px overflow from the long 'getClientCapabilities()' h2 at 360px found during verification).

summary: Composition page verified headless; the dual-surface UI behaviour requires a headed manual check.
